text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Integrating MemGPT’s external‑memory paging mechanism with the rewrite‑based memory update will alleviate the token‑budget overflow observed for naive append (which exceeds the budget by day 20) and should further boost F1 performance beyond the ~9‑point gain already reported for rewrite alone.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["c0fbabea","f167ace6","5f5331d2"],"tags":["memory","token_budget","external_memory","rewrite"]},{"statement":"Applying compression‑based consolidation techniques (as shown to reduce cross‑fact interference and outperform accumulation) to the rewritten memory snapshots will improve long‑term recall and reduce fact interference in lifelong agents, potentially raising reviewer scores that currently critique memory interference.","confidence":0.65,"support_ids":["03c1d4c1","579b3852","239b8cff","c0fbabea"],"tags":["memory","consolidation","lifelong_learning","interference"]}]}
